Due to a permanent signal interference zone, a direct flight corridor between Station Alpha and Station Beta is unavailable for navigation.
Furthermore, due to overlapping scheduling constraints, exactly one of the following two flight segments must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the segment between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the segment between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop flight path that visits every monitoring station precisely once before returning to the origin, thereby minimizing the total distance traversed.
